g.text: STEP 1 — Set up
• Fit the anchorage wedges by hand and tap home.
• Drop the jack onto the strand through the side slot.
• Seat the nose pads flat on the anchorage casting.
• Mark the strand at the jack rear face (datum for
measuring elongation). Record datum reading.
STEP 2 — Stress
body travels rearward
• Pump slowly. The rods push on the yoke, the body
and gripper move rearward and tension the strand.
• Stop at 20% of target, re-check alignment, then
continue in stages and record pressure vs elongation.
• STOP at the calibrated target pressure — never at
a target elongation. Elongation is the cross-check.
STEP 3 — Seat & release
release lever
• Hold on the pilot check while the anchorage wedges
pull in. Allow for anchor set (draw-in) ≈ 6 mm.
• Lower the pressure SLOWLY to zero, then retract.
• Push the release lever, lift the jack off sideways.
• Repeat if the required elongation needs a 2nd pull.
DANGER ZONE — NO PERSON BEHIND OR IN LINE WITH THE JACK AT ANY TIME
If a strand fails or the wedges slip, the jack and the strand tail are launched along the tendon axis at high velocity. The exclusion zone extends at least 10 m behind the jack.
Operators stand to the SIDE. A steel deflector/blast shield is placed behind the jack. Hoses carry whip restraints. Nobody may pass the live end while pressure is on.
Never exceed the pressure corresponding to 0.80 × GUTS. Never re-use a wedge set on a strand of a different diameter. Never operate with a cracked or repaired nose yoke.
Every stressing record must state: tendon ID, strand Ø, gauge serial, jack serial, target pressure, measured elongation, calculated elongation, and the operator's name.
ELONGATION CROSS-CHECK
δ = F · L / (A · E) where F = jacking force [N], L = tendon length [mm], A = strand area [mm²], E = strand modulus (195 000 MPa, use the mill certificate value)
Example: 0.6" strand (A = 140 mm²), L = 30 m, F = 208.3 kN (0.80 GUTS) ⇒ δ = 208 300 × 30 000 / (140 × 195 000) = 229 mm ⇒ two pulls of the 200 mm stroke.
Acceptance: measured elongation must be within −5% / +5% of calculated (PTI / ACI 423). Outside that band — STOP and investigate before proceeding.
DWG PT-JACK-07 · Rev A · Sheet 7 of 7
